title: Shoggoth wall art — round 01 mood board

cards.title: Giger Xenomorph biomechanical skin
cards.rationale: Museum-quality photograph of Giger's Xenomorph sculpture surface; probes how much mechanical ribbing vs fleshy tube density to pack into the shoggoth body.

cards.title: Giger bar vertebral arch relief
cards.rationale: Wide-angle interior of the Giger Bar Gruyères; shows how repeated vertebral-rib modules tile across a large surface — directly relevant to tiling the 3x3 ft print.

cards.title: Beksiński mummified embrace decay
cards.rationale: Canonical Beksiński decayed-flesh color palette and calcified-skin texture; probes whether the shoggoth surface reads as dried/petrified organic vs wet/viscous.

cards.title: Beksiński AA78 dystopian figure
cards.rationale: AA78's layered cracked-earth and bone-crust surfaces calibrate how much of Beksiński's desolate-ochre tone should bleed into the shoggoth's color treatment.

cards.title: Kraken tentacle porthole burst
cards.rationale: PLA print of a tentacle erupting through a porthole frame, hung on drywall; probes whether the shoggoth reads better as a contained-silhouette relief or as limbs escaping beyond any border.

cards.title: Cthulhu FDM wall relief mounted
cards.rationale: 4096px community photo of a printed Cthulhu hanging flush on plaster; shows the flat-backed full-body wall-relief format and how layer lines read at scale.

cards.title: Xenomorph trophy taxidermy plaque
cards.rationale: Printed Xenomorph head on a wooden taxidermy plaque hung on wood-panel wall; probes the full-bust-trophy format vs flat relief — whether the shoggoth should read as a hunted thing.

cards.title: Giger bar architectural wall columns
cards.rationale: Giger Bar window bay where biomechanical sculpture is the wall itself — probes whether the shoggoth piece should frame or merge with its mounting surface rather than stand proud of it.

cards.title: Hannya Noh demon mask TNM
cards.rationale: Tokyo National Museum Hannya: horned demon with frozen snarl — graphic mask form that is itself horror; probes whether the shoggoth's smiley mask should be purely benign or carry menace.

cards.title: Aztec skull trophy mask
cards.rationale: Real human skull fitted with mosaic inlays as a ceremonial mask; the clearest analog to the concept — a recognizable graphic face applied to raw organic material, testing how that contrast reads in 3D.

cards.title: Plague doctor beak mask
cards.rationale: Clean graphic beak form photographed against pure black; probes how much the smiley mask needs visual isolation or rim-lighting to read as a singular clean element amid tentacle chaos.

cards.title: Shoggoth fan art organic chaos
cards.rationale: Canonical Shoggoth rendering with writhing tentacles and scattered eyes; establishes what the smiley mask is embedded in — probes scale and placement of a clean icon against that density.
